whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Tera & Mera Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.3★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table bookings and food delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservation, aur signature dishes integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/teramera

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Tera & Mera Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Tera & Mera Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, and a showcase of your top-rated food in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photography aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
